name.la: In Ezram et Neemiam libri III

description.la: Allegorica expositio in Esdram et Neemiam libri tres.
description.en-US: Bede's three-book allegorical commentary on Ezra and Nehemiah: the return from exile and the rebuilding of Jerusalem as figures of the Church. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: O comentário alegórico de Beda, em três livros, a Esdras e Neemias: o retorno do exílio e a reconstrução de Jerusalém como figuras da Igreja.

sources.edition: Allegorica expositio in Esdram et Nehemiam on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
